title: 佛经详解：禅宗经典 — Day 4
title_en: Buddhist Sutra Deep Dive: Chan Classics — Day 4

questions.question: 《坛经》所说的「无念」指的是什么？
options: 念头照样生起，只是不黏上去、不跟着走
停止一切概念思考，让心维持一片空白
只起善念、不起恶念，让心保持清净
通过长期坐禅把念头压住，达到一念不生
questions.explanation: 文章强调无念是「于念而离念」，说的是心的一种运作方式，不是要维持的空白状态。把它当成「什么都不想」去练，练出来的是昏沉；把念头压住则正是慧能所说的「法缚」。
questions.question_en: What does "no-thought" mean in the Platform Sutra?
options_en: Thoughts still arise; you just don't cling to them or follow them
Halting all conceptual thinking so the mind stays blank
Giving rise only to good thoughts and never bad ones, keeping the mind pure
Suppressing thoughts through long sitting until not a single one arises
questions.explanation_en: The piece stresses that no-thought means being amid thoughts without being caught by them — a way the mind operates, not a blank state to maintain. Practicing it as "thinking nothing" produces dullness, and pressing thoughts down is exactly the bondage Huineng warns against.

questions.question: 《永嘉证道歌》「无明实性即佛性」一句，文章认为它颠覆在哪里？
options: 必须先充分经历无明，它是通往佛性不可跳过的阶段
佛性被无明遮蔽，所以要时时勤拂拭、不使惹尘埃
不必先除尽无明再证佛性，当下识取无明的本性就是佛性
无明与佛性本是两样东西，须靠修行一步步转化
questions.explanation: 文章说这是禅最颠覆的洞见：修行不是从此岸到彼岸，而是识取此岸本身就是彼岸。「时时勤拂拭」是神秀的偈，属于把心当镜子擦的思路，正是这句话要翻过去的。
questions.question_en: Yongjia's Song of Enlightenment says "the true nature of ignorance is Buddha-nature." What makes this line radical, per the piece?
options_en: Ignorance must be fully lived through first, as an unskippable stage on the way to Buddha-nature
Buddha-nature is covered by ignorance, so you must keep wiping it so no dust collects
You needn't eliminate ignorance before realizing Buddha-nature; recognizing ignorance's own nature right now is it
Ignorance and Buddha-nature are two separate things, converted step by step through practice
questions.explanation_en: The piece calls it Chan's most subversive insight: practice isn't crossing from this shore to the other; it's recognizing this shore as the other. "Keep wiping the mirror" is Shenxiu's verse — the polish-the-mirror approach this line overturns.

questions.question: 大慧宗杲为什么烧掉师父圜悟克勤《碧岩录》的书版？
options: 书中的评唱有错，偏离了雪窦重显颂古的原意
圜悟的评唱太精彩，学人执着文字，反而成了新的缠缚
他主张回归经论研读，反对一切祖师语录
朝廷下令禁止公案集流通，他只得奉命销毁
questions.explanation: 文章说学人执着公案文字反成新缠缚，大慧便焚版、改倡专参一个「无」字的看话禅——「连最珍贵的也敢烧，这本身就是禅」。他并不是回到经论，而是更彻底地离开文字。
questions.question_en: Why did Dahui Zonggao burn the printing blocks of his teacher Yuanwu's Blue Cliff Record?
options_en: The commentary contained errors that strayed from Xuedou's original verses
Yuanwu's commentary was so brilliant that students clung to the words, which became a new bondage
He wanted a return to sutra study and rejected all records of the masters' sayings
The court banned kōan collections and he had to destroy the blocks on orders
questions.explanation_en: The piece says students grew attached to the kōan texts, turning them into a fresh entanglement, so Dahui burned the blocks and promoted huatou practice — investigating the single word "Wu." "Daring to burn even the most precious thing is itself Chan." He wasn't returning to scripture but leaving words behind even more thoroughly.
